changes_from_v1_1: d' is measured on a deterministic image-disjoint train holdout instead of an unspecified or Gate-1-derived split. The head trains on the complement of the holdout.
The operating cell is fixed at target size 4 units, opacity 1.0. The fit pool remains null-only for standardisers, VIFs, and kappa.
E2/E5 scenes use a balanced size assignment (2, 4, 6) and a size-conditioned posterior. This is not a size-inference claim.
E2 primary ECE is fixed at K=8 on the full test pool; per-size and per-K values are diagnostics.
E5 primary risk is selective committed error P(decided AND wrong); forced-answer error is secondary. k_min is fixed at 1 before calibration.
The lambda grid is fixed. The plug-in conservative control is reported as a diagnostic, not used as a pass/fail criterion.
The v1.1 markdown draft is unchanged and remains pinned by the v1.1 file.

train_holdout.rule: per class: sorted train file names; first 16 target-class images and first 32 background-class images are held out; the head trains on the complement

sensor_contract.head_training: the complement of prereg/gate2_train_holdout.json in data/imagenet100/train/; 600 steps, batch 48, AdamW, lr 2e-3, cosine decay, seed matching evaluation seed; no persistent head checkpoint required
sensor_contract.d_prime_fit: 800 target scenes (size 4, opacity 1.0) and 800 null scenes built only from prereg/gate2_train_holdout.json; no image reused within this fit
sensor_contract.fit_pool_role: 850 non-reused null scenes from fit_pool_part_0_of_3 for mu0, sigma0, vif_tok, vif_gist, and kappa
sensor_contract.d_prime: d_tok is the measured 8x8 token map at the operating cell; d_gist is the positive-count-weighted mean of the measured gist map at the operating cell; both must be finite
sensor_contract.vif: vif_tok and vif_gist measured on fit-pool null scenes with operating-cell d' weights; each correction is applied only if finite and > 1.25, otherwise the factor is 1.0
sensor_contract.kappa: 99.9th percentile of absolute VIF-corrected null scores (native and gist pooled); must be finite
sensor_contract.combination_mode: measured from rho_null on two independent native windows per d'-fit scene: sum if rho_null <= 0.2, otherwise best
sensor_contract.no_fallback: a missing or non-finite required sensor quantity refuses the run; Gate 1 values are never substituted

scene_plans.unit: one target/background image pair for a target scene, or one background image for a null scene; no within-pool image reuse
scene_plans.size_conditioned_posterior: each scene is evaluated with the footprint of its assigned evaluation size, including null scenes; no claim is made about inferring target size from pixels
scene_plans.disjoint_unit_contract: zero cross-pool image reuse across fit, calibration, test, and train-holdout; no train image is used for both head training and d'

look_policy.look_1: resampled 112x112 gist view of the entire 224x224 canvas
look_policy.looks_2_to_8: seeded independent draws (with replacement) from the 25 native 112x112 window candidate locations; deterministic function of scene seed and look step

E2_posterior_calibration.primary: ECE_15_equal_frequency_bins at K=8 on the full 800-scene test pool
E2_posterior_calibration.per_size: ECE at K=8 for the size-2, size-4, and size-6 subsets

E5_risk_controlled_stopping.primary_risk: selective committed error P(decided AND wrong)
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.validity_criterion: empirical violation rate <= delta = 0.10 across resamples
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.efficiency_criterion: mean looks saved vs K=8 horizon >= 25% at matched or lower committed error
E5_risk_controlled_stopping.conservative_control_criterion: reported as a diagnostic; fixed-threshold plug-in violation rate; not part of pass/fail

aggregation.E2: PASS if at least 2 seeds PASS; INCONCLUSIVE if not PASS but at least 2 seeds are PASS or INCONCLUSIVE; otherwise FAIL
aggregation.E5: validity and efficiency each aggregated 2-of-3; E5 PASS requires both

code_locking.requirement: all measurement code and execution scripts must be pinned by SHA-256 before any data execution
